# requireSlide

<link-summary>Returns the value as a slide, or throws.</link-summary>

<web-summary>requireSlide() — Returns the value as a slide, or throws. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/slide</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function requireSlide(
  value: unknown,
  message: string = "Required Slide context is missing or invalid."
): GoogleAppsScript.Slides.Slide;
```

An Apps Script service object has no constructor a script can test against, so the guard looks for the methods that define the type — `getObjectId`, `getPageElementById`. A stub that implements them passes, which is what makes code using this guard testable outside the runtime.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter                                                                  | Type      | Description                                                   |
| :------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `value`                                                                    | `unknown` | The value to validate.                                        |
| `message` _(optional)_ `= "Required Slide context is missing or invalid."` | `string`  | The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted. |

## Returns

`GoogleAppsScript.Slides.Slide` — the same value, typed as a slide.

## Throws

| Exception                | Condition                 |
| :----------------------- | :------------------------ |
| `SlideNotFoundException` | the value is not a slide. |

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
const slide = SlidesApp.getActivePresentation().getSlides()[0];

requireSlide(slide); // => slide
requireSlide({}); // throws SlideNotFoundException
requireSlide(null); // throws SlideNotFoundException
```
